taxonomy_note: Workflow routing only. Choose final root-cause taxonomy from supported evidence.

controls.boundary: Server-Sent Events stream identity and per-event resource filtering
controls.source_trace: Follow requester identity into channel/cursor selection and each emitted object. Check replay/resume without replacing current authorization with a cursor capability by accident.
controls.implementation_branch: Last-Event-ID can be a resume position rather than a bearer credential. Reapply the current actor/resource filter to replayed events. Distinguish broker events already authorized and buffered before revocation from new events, and do not equate HTTP stream establishment with delivery of protected data.
controls.controlled_verification: Use two owned streams and synthetic events; compare normal subscribe/resume with a foreign cursor/channel and a revoked membership.
controls.false_positive_discriminator: A kept-alive response or guessed channel name is not cross-user event exposure; prove an unauthorized synthetic event is delivered.
controls.remediation_acceptance: Bind stream/cursor access to current policy and verify entitled resume plus restricted event exclusion.
